item.title: Khaleda Zia's death won't affect polls in 3 seats: EC
item.description: The Election Commission (EC) has confirmed that the death of BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia will not disrupt the election schedule in three constituencies where nomination papers were submitted in her name, as her passing occurred before the scrutiny of nominations began.Nomination papers were filed in Khaleda Zia's name for Feni-1, Bogura-7 and Dinajpur-3 ahead of the upcoming 13th national parliamentary election. item.title: TOP LEADERS Who are not in Feb polls
item.description: A significant number of senior and top leaders from various political parties are skipping the upcoming 13th National Parliamentary Election and referendum, scheduled to be held on February 12, as they did not collect or submit nomination papers by the deadline on Monday, December 29.According to Election Commission (EC) Secretary Akhtar Hossain, out of 59 registered political parties, 51 parties are contesting the polls. item.title: Bangladesh observing state mourning

item.title: Khaleda Zia's body taken to Gulshan residence

item.title: Tarique Rahman recites Quran beside mother's coffin

item.title: Khaleda Zia's body taken to Manik Mia Avenure

item.title: Global 'fragmentation' fuelling world's crises: UN refugee chief
item.description: The outgoing United Nations refugee chief fears an increasingly fragmented world is fuelling global conflicts and crises, and inflaming hostility towards people desperately fleeing for safety.Reflecting on his decade at the helm of the UNHCR, Filippo Grandi told AFP that one of the most worrying developments had been how divisions had left the world seemingly incapable of resolving conflicts -- and increasingly unwilling to deal with the repercussions."This fragmentation of geopolitics that has

item.title: Khaleda Zia's body at South Plaza of Jatiya Sangsad, janaza at 2PM
item.description: Amid strong security, the body of BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia was taken to the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad, where her namaz-e-janaza will be held at 2PM.The funeral prayer will be conducted by the Khatib of the National Mosque, Baitul Mukarram, Mufti Mohammad Abdul Malek.Defying severe cold and dense fog, thousands of mourners gathered at Manik Mia Avenue to attended the janaza and bid farewell to Begum Zia.
